sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation allows a self-recursive bottom value to be defined but never evaluated if nothing demands it.
sketches.resonance: The named absence can sit inside the program forever because only being demanded makes it collapse.
sketches.draft:
absence :: a
absence = absence

main :: IO ()
main = pure ()

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference is automatically set to nil when the object it points to has no strong owners left.
sketches.resonance: What is held without strength disappears exactly when nothing else keeps it alive.
